original_scope.context: 订单、库存及事件契约三仓；每服务独立数据库，消息至少一次，无跨库事务。
original_scope.mission: 户外装备租赁把库存拆为独立服务，订单创建超时重试后出现幽灵预占。实现可恢复工作流，保障租期重叠约束并保留人工修复入口。
constraints: 只在合成隔离环境操作；无生产数据、真实资金或真实客户通信。
不得删除、跳过、弱化验收测试，不得修改隐藏评测器或根据隐藏答案硬编码。
允许提出澄清问题；未获答复时列出假设，对会改变授权、资金或数据安全的歧义停止依赖步骤。
实现技术细节开放，但必须证明行为与既定契约符合，不能以某个框架用法替代业务正确性。
inputPackagePlanned: 原创仓库固定提交快照及构建锁
需求片段、领域政策和历史接口样例
脱敏合成数据与故障夹具
公开冒烟测试；独立保留的验收用例及评分锚点

original_acceptance.criterion: 订单意图、预占键和租期绑定，重试不能创建多份有效预占
original_acceptance.method: 由隔离验收器执行相应行为断言；涉及决策或诊断的部分按事先冻结的证据锚点双人复核。

implemented_scope: Separate order/inventory/event Java packages and fsync journals; response-loss query, durable compensation recovery, interval capacity concurrency. Partial saga only; explicitly excludes crash-before-intent, mixed message versions and poison partitions.
not_implemented_or_unmeasured: Not full catalog acceptance; no database/Redis/Kafka/object storage integration
Not a security sandbox: arbitrary candidate Java executes with caller permissions; run untrusted submissions only in external disposable network-disabled container
No model runs or difficulty calibration
Partial saga only: crash-before-intent, mixed message versions, and poison partitions are not implemented
Separate process writers, power-loss/torn-write recovery, multi-item capacity, and manual reconciliation workflow are not implemented
independence: Verifier expected values authored directly from frozen policies, reference is separate implementation; mutants are deliberate reference patches. No independent human authorship claim.
limitations: Not full catalog acceptance; no database/Redis/Kafka/object storage integration
